type: 1500 lockstitch sewing machine with S68 electronic control
note: The 1500 uses the S68 controller — same hardware as the 8770 model. S68 manual version v1.1 (bilingual CN/EN). The MAC parameter [047] determines machine head type (default value 630 shown in manual; verify actual MAC code for 1500 vs 8770 with machine head manufacturer). All S68 parameters and error codes are shared between 1500 and 8770. Key distinguishing factor is MAC code in Level B parameters.

specs.maxSpeed: 200-7000 spm (H parameter); upper limit HL [122] = 4200 spm default
specs.parameterLevels: Level A (normal user — press P briefly in standby, first code 001) | Level B (technician — hold P + power on, first code 047) | Level C (factory — hold S + power on, first code 123)
specs.monitoringAccess: Press P + S(number key) combo in standby; default shows 06 (mechanical angle)
specs.autoTest: Press P + S combo to enter auto-test interface
specs.saveUserParams: Method 1: hold S key + power on → navigate to [123.FAS] → press A key. Method 2: in monitor mode, hold D key until '------' displays then release
specs.restoreUserParams: Method 1: hold A+B keys + power on. Method 2: in monitor mode, hold D key until '------' displays then release
specs.restoreFactoryParams: Enter Level B → set parameter [047] to target model MAC code → press S key to confirm
specs.factoryResetNote: Only allowed by machine head manufacturer

errorCodes.cause: Over current for hardware — hardware overcurrent fault
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, restart after 15 seconds. If controller still does not work, replace controller and inform manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Main board storage failure — EEPROM fault
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, restart after 15 seconds. If still does not work, replace controller and inform manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Over voltage during standby mode — input voltage too high (higher than 264V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power. Check if input voltage is too high (>264V). Restart controller when normal voltage is resumed. If still does not work at normal voltage, replace controller.

errorCodes.cause: System under voltage — input voltage too low (lower than 176V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power. Check if input voltage is too low (<176V). Restart controller when normal voltage is resumed. If still does not work, replace controller.

errorCodes.cause: Motor stalled — motor connector loose, objects stuck in pulley, or sewing material too thick
errorCodes.solution: Motor and machine will be shutting down. Check motor or motor connectors' connection. Check machine head to see if objects stuck in motor pulley or if it does not rotate smoothly.

errorCodes.cause: Communication error — operation panel cable loose or panel not connected
errorCodes.solution: Motor and machine will be shutting down. Check the operation panel and the cable of the operation panel.

errorCodes.cause: Solenoid circuit failure — solenoid not connected correctly, loose, or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power. Check if the solenoid is connected correctly, loose, or damaged. If any defect, replace immediately. Restart system and check function. If still does not work, inform technical support.

errorCodes.cause: Current checking circuit failure — current sensing circuit fault
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, restart after 15 seconds. Check whether it works well. If not, try several more times. If same failure happens frequently, inform service after sales.

errorCodes.cause: Brake circuit failure — white resistance cable on main board loose or disconnected
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, check if the cable of the white resistance is loose or disconnecting to the jack on the main board. Reconnect and restart. If still does not work, replace controller.

errorCodes.cause: Motor hall failure — motor sensor plug loose or disconnected
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, check if the motor sensor plug is loose or disconnecting. Reconnect and restart. If still does not work, replace controller.

errorCodes.cause: Motor over-speed failure — optical encoder grating dirty
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, restart after 15 seconds. Check if motor grating is dirty and affecting photo-electric signal. If still does not work, replace controller.

errorCodes.cause: Motor reversion — encoder grating dirty causing wrong direction detection
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, restart after 15 seconds. Check if motor grating is dirty and affecting photo-electric signal. If still does not work, replace controller.

errorCodes.cause: HMI read/write EEPROM — panel memory failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, restart after 15 seconds. If still does not work, replace controller. Note: during power-on process do NOT step on pedal. Wait for controller to fully power on before stepping.

errorCodes.cause: Cutting protection switch — safety switch signal detected; motor icon on LCD halting and not rotating
errorCodes.solution: Check safety switch is not faulty or has bad connection. Restart system to check if fault is removed. Check parameter [075.SFM] setting — must match machine head safety switch type (NO or NC). Note: parameter [145.IN2] setting enables or disables this function.

errorCodes.cause: Pedal failure — pedal not properly connected
errorCodes.solution: Check that the pedal is properly connected to the controller.

troubleshooting.symptom: ER0.119 cutting protection switch — motor icon halting on display
checks: Check safety switch connection and condition
Verify parameter [075.SFM] matches the machine head safety switch type (NO or NC)
Check parameter [145.IN2] — set to 0 to disable this function if switch is not present

troubleshooting.symptom: ER0.117 HMI EEPROM error after starting up
checks: During power-on process, do NOT step on pedal
Wait for controller to fully power on before stepping on pedal

troubleshooting.symptom: Pedal calibration needed (machine speed response abnormal)
checks: Enter Level C parameters (hold S + power on)
Check and adjust pedal points: [365] trim=120, [366] foot=300, [367] neutral=470, [368] low=480, [369] accel=600, [370] max=940
Monitor parameter 05 shows real-time pedal digital value for diagnosis
Method 1 (motor with sensor and magnet): Adjust needle bar to target up position, then adjust stop-needle magnet to sensor position
Method 2 (motor without sensor): Enter monitor mode (P+S combo); view monitor 06 for mechanical angle; turn handwheel to up position; hold D key until machine saves position automatically and exits
